scenario: Level 2 Build: 2-layer MLP (16-32-4, 676 parameters) trained with NumPy on a synthetic Gaussian mixture, quantized, pruned, serialized in QLAB format, and benchmarked on CPU
substitutions: QLAB container format, designed for this project, is used instead of GGUF. QLAB is not GGUF and no file here runs in llama.cpp, which is unavailable on this machine.
The pruning rows are a NumPy equivalent track. The TensorFlow Model Optimization Toolkit row did not run because TensorFlow is unavailable on this machine.
No GPU was used. BlackBox was unreachable this cycle (NEEDS-BLACKBOX-ON). All timing is CPU timing on this machine.
timing_note: timing_ms_median is the median of 15 full test-set forward passes on this machine (CPU, single machine, varying load), on dequantized weights for quantized variants. It is the only nondeterministic field in this file.
